messages:
lee: Noticed quota dashboard shows tenant C-900 hitting free-tier cap but invoice-preview shows zero tokens for the same period. Possible metering path split (realtime vs batch) mismatch.
sophia: Huh. Could be that realtime path emitted quota-used metric but batching pipeline dropped route metadata so tokens weren't attributed to invoice lines.
ari: I pulled a sample: realtime.event has route_tag and quota_id; batch.event missing route_tag and has fallback tenant_id only. That leaves invoice join ambiguous.
lee: For immediate fix, we can backfill route tags for the batch events using sidecar enrichment from realtime snapshots (join on session_id). Short-term job?
sophia: We should also add a cross-path checksum metric: when a request flows realtime->batch, emit trace_id in both and surface mismatch rates.
ari: Agree. I'll add trace_id propagation in consumer v2. Also propose adding an alert: batch.missing_route_rate > 0.1% -> notify eng-platform.
lee: UX: Console should surface 'unattributed_quota' lines in invoice-preview with a suggested remediation link and expansion to show candidate realtime events.
ops-bot: Pager duty test run scheduled for 2025-05-01 09:00 UTC. Rule: batch.missing_route_rate > 0.1% alerts eng-platform.
sophia: Plan: 1) run backfill job for last 72h, 2) enable trace_id propagation in canary, 3) ship dashboard checksum card. I'll own 1 and 3. ari takes 2.
ari: On it. I'll open PR and include integration test that verifies trace_id appears in both paths.
lee: Thanks team. Will post backfill job link once queued.
